subject: general
question: Anil Pradhan, co-founder of NGO Young Tinker Foundation, working towards education in underserved areas, awarded with Rohini Nayyar Prize for Outstanding Contribution to Rural Development in 2024, belongs to which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anil Pradhan**, co-founder of the **Young Tinker Foundation**, has been recognized for his efforts in improving **education in underserved areas**.
 
• He was awarded the **Rohini Nayyar Prize for Outstanding Contribution to Rural Development in 2024**.
 
• **Anil Pradhan** hails from the state of **Odisha**, located in eastern India.
 
• The **Young Tinker Foundation**, co-founded by Pradhan, focuses on providing **innovative educational solutions** for rural and underprivileged communities, promoting hands-on learning and skill development.
 
• Odisha, the state of his origin, is known for its **rich cultural heritage**, including **Odissi dance**, ancient temples like the **Konark Sun Temple**, and its **diverse tribal communities**.
 
• The award highlights Anil's significant role in addressing **rural educational challenges** and creating positive social impact through his initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **West Bengal**__

 __
 
• West Bengal is a state in eastern India, known for its **cultural landmarks** such as the **Victoria Memorial** and its literary figures like **Rabindranath Tagore**.
 
• The state is also recognized for its contributions to **education and social reform** during the colonial era.
 
• Although West Bengal has a history of rural development initiatives, it is not the home state of Anil Pradhan.
 
 
 
• **Assam**__
 __
 
• Assam is situated in northeastern India and is famous for its **tea plantations** and the **Kaziranga National Park**, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
• It has made significant strides in rural development but is not associated with the achievements of Anil Pradhan.
 
 
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh**__
 
 
• Arunachal Pradesh, located in the northeastern region of India, is known for its **pristine natural beauty** and **indigenous tribal cultures**.
 
• Though rural development is a focus in this state, it is not linked to the work of Anil Pradhan or the Young Tinker Foundation.
